column2: Bhukha, hambisa futhi uqedele imali yephasela ngalinye — uhlelo olulodwa lwamaphasela kumadivayisi akho.

Izinhlangothi, izincwadi, i-COD, amalebula, amaqoqo ezinombolo ze-AWB, ukulandelela, abalethi namabhili — wonke umjikelezo kusukela ekhawunteni kuze kuqedwe imali, kungaba ne-inthanethi noma ngaphandle kwayo. Mahhala kumadivayisi akho.
Isisindo sangempela nesisindo sevolumu, eceleni komunye nomunye.
Ikhadi lakho lamanani, ukheshi noma i-akhawunti.
Ukuthepha kanye kusula ikhawunta ukuze kungene ofikayo olandelayo.
Skrola — umzila wohambo lwephasela ngenhla ukhombisa ukuthi ukuphi endabeni.
Isisindo sangempela noma isisindo sevolumu — esikhulu kunesinye, sijikelezwe ngendlela yakho.
Esikhulu kulezi ezimbili, sijikelezwe sikhuphukele ku-0,5 kg olandelayo.

Ku-app, isitolo sisetha isihlukanisi, isinyathelo sokujikeleza namayunithi akho (cm noma ama-intshi, kg noma i-lb). Inkinobho ethi Emazweni angaphandle isebenzisa u-÷6000 ekubhukeni okukodwa ngaphandle kokuthinta Izilungiselelo.
Amakhadi akho amanani, amanani ezinhlangothi zakho — nenzuzo yakho kuyo yonke idokhethi.
Izinga lokuqala nezinga ngalinye elengeziwe, ngezoni nangesevisi.
Abathumeli abavamile bathola amanani abo; ikhadi elijwayelekile limboza bonke abanye.
Intengo yakho yokuthengisa uma iqhathaniswa nentengo yomthwali, kuyo yonke idokhethi.
I-AWB evela kumaqoqo akho ezinombolo. Faka ilebula, skena, thola.
Faka uchungechunge lokuqala–lokugcina lomthwali ngamunye kanye; ukubhuka ngakunye kuthatha inombolo elandelayo.
I-AWB ibekwa ebhokisini njengebhakhodi nangezinombolo ezicacile.
Skena ilebula ukuze uvule idokhethi yayo futhi wenze okudingekayo.
Nikela kumthwali, noma uthumele umlethi wakho. Uhlelo olufanayo.
Uhlu lwamaphasela luqukethe kanye lawo maphasela owakhethile — wonke noma lutho. Iphasela elibhukhwe komunye umthwali alikwazi ukungena kulesi sikhwama.
Khetha amaphasela, phrinta ishidi lohambo, futhi umlethi usebenza ku-app efanayo ngemodi yomlethi — kanye nobufakazi bokulethwa.
Konke ukunyakaza kuyabhalwa — futhi ukunyakaza okunengqondo kuphela.
→ isizathu → iphinde iphume, noma ibuyiselwe kumthumeli.
Izizathu, imizamo, ukuphinda kuphume, noma ukubuyela kumthumeli.
I-COD ongayibona: elindelekile, enikelwe, ekweletwa umthumeli ngamunye.
Kushode ₹ 200 ku-Umlethi B — kushiwo, akulahlekanga engqikithini.
Okuqoqiwe kuqhathaniswa nokukhokhiwe, ngomthumeli ngamunye, namaqoqo okuthunyelwa kwemali.
Incwadi yosuku, ibhili lenyanga nge-akhawunti ngayinye, kanye nesifinyezo se-GST nge-CSV somgcinimabhuku wakho.
Ukubhuka, amalebula, ukuskena, i-COD nezincwadi konke kusebenza kumadivayisi akho. Uma i-inthanethi inqamuka, akukho lutho ekhawunteni olulinda yona.
Ikhawunta yesibili nefoni yomlethi: kuxhumene nge-Wi-Fi yasehhovisi
Akukho ukukhokhiswa ngomlethi, umsebenzisi noma iphasela. I-Kumkaj Cloud ozikhethela yona: Steady ₹6k · Swift ₹12k · Priority ₹24k/ngonyaka ngaphandle kwentela — /shop.
Uhlelo olulodwa lwamaphasela. Amaphasela akho. Izincwadi zakho.
I-Moklanjo iwuhlelo oluphelele lokuphatha amaphasela ngaphansi kwe-Kumkaj — Android, Windows ne-Linux. Abalethi basebenzisa i-app efanayo ngemodi yomlethi.
Igama lesi-Memon elisho “yithole” · liphinyiswa ngokuthi go-tee-geen
Izifaki zizofakwa lapha uma ngasinye sesiphumelele ukufakwa emshinini omusha. Kuze kube yileso sikhathi, cela umboniso ku-WhatsApp.
Ulayini womboniso we-WhatsApp uzovuleka maduze. Umlayezo wakho uzofundeka kanje: “{message}”.
I-akhawunti eyodwa yesayithi nama-app — ifomu elifanayo noma umusha noma ubuyayo.
Sizokuthumelela isixhumanisi sokusetha kabusha nge-imeyili. Sebenzisa ikheli olifanayo obhalise ngalo.
Xhumanisa izindlela ne-akhawunti efanayo ukuze ukwazi ukubuyisa ukufinyelela uma enye yehluleka.
Izinhlelo zefu zonyaka — intela yengezwa lapho ukhokha. I-app ephelele ye-Moklanjo kumadivayisi akho ihlala imahhala unomphela, ngaphandle kwezikhangiso.
Inqola yakho ayinalutho. Engeza i-Steady, i-Swift noma i-Priority.
Ukukhokha kukungenisa ekhasini le-akhawunti, bese kuqala inkokhelo (ukulingisa kokuhlola noma i-Paddle uma okhiye sebesethiwe).

Izinhlelo zonyaka — isango lokukhokha lengeza intela lapho ukhokha. Ukusebenzisa kudivayisi yakho kuhlala kumahhala unomphela. Okwenziwe ngokwezifiso kuyisilinganiso sentengo (kungaba ngaphansi kwe-Steady noma ngaphezu kwe-Priority).
Imizamo eminingi kakhulu. Zama futhi emuva kwesikhathi.
Sebenzisa inombolo yocingo ephelele enekhodi yezwe (isib. +91…).
Leyo khodi ye-SMS ayilungile noma iphelelwe yisikhathi.
Ayikho i-akhawunti ene-imeyili leyo. Qhubeka ukuze uyidale, noma usebenzise enye indlela.
Ngokuphepha, ngena futhi, bese uzama lolu shintsho futhi.
Leyo ndlela yokungena isisetshenziswa enye i-akhawunti.
Kukhona i-akhawunti esivele ikhona ene-imeyili le esebenzisa enye indlela yokungena. Ngena ngaleyo ndlela kuqala, bese uxhumanisa le ndlela ekhasini le-akhawunti yakho.
Engeza iphasiwedi ukuze ukwazi ukungena nange-imeyili (kuyasiza uma umhlinzeki engatholakali).
Awukho umhlinzeki wangempela wokukhokha ovuliwe ku-API yefu (ukulingisa kuphela okusekudivayisi yakho).
Ukukhokha kuvaliwe — ayikho inkokhelo eqediwe. Uhlelo lwakho alushintshile.
I-imeyili ayikaqinisekiswa — bheka ibhokisi lakho lemiyalezo
I-akhawunti idaliwe. Bheka i-imeyili yakho ukuze uqinisekise uma uthola ithuba.
Uma kukhona i-akhawunti yaleyo imeyili, isixhumanisi sokusetha kabusha sisendleleni. Bheka ibhokisi lakho lemiyalezo.
I-akhawunti ka-{email} isivele ikhona nge-{method}. Ngena ngaleyo ndlela kuqala, bese uxhumanisa lo mhlinzeki ekhasini le-akhawunti yakho.
Phuma bese ungena futhi, bese uzama futhi.
I-imeyili yokuqinisekisa ithunyelwe — bheka ibhokisi lakho lemiyalezo.
Amanani okuzithengela awakashicilelwa kulo mkhiqizo. Cela isilinganiso sentengo esenziwe ngokwezifiso noma ubuye kamuva.
Umkhiqizo ophelele kumadivayisi akho. Ayikho imali yefu.
